cci_presence_codes.explicit_time: full quoted text identifies current/date-specific state
cci_presence_codes.explicit_condition: full quote states the distance/going/class/tactical condition
cci_presence_codes.explicit_comparison: full quote explicitly compares this horse with its identified prior state
cci_presence_codes.explicit_uncertainty: full quote states a concrete conditional limitation or uncertainty
cci_presence_codes.false: the complete quoted context was inspected and the specific dimension is absent
cci_presence_codes.unknown: text/context/coder agreement absent -> whole component UNKNOWN

muscle_grades.0: same-horse same-site measured muscle thickness decreased beyond instrument uncertainty
muscle_grades.1: same protocol paired thickness uncertainty intervals overlap
muscle_grades.2: same-horse same-site measured muscle thickness increased beyond uncertainty; independent growth cause evidence required
muscle_grades.unknown: visual impression, age alone, noncomparable site or unmeasured uncertainty -> UNKNOWN

state_grades.0: paired same-horse rubric corroborates poorer condition
state_grades.1: paired same-horse rubric corroborates unchanged condition
state_grades.2: paired same-horse rubric corroborates improved condition
state_grades.unknown: no matched before/after state observations or no prespecified seasonal comparator -> UNKNOWN

paddock_grades.0: both observers identify a concrete adverse change against dated same-horse baseline
paddock_grades.1: both observers corroborate unchanged within baseline variation
paddock_grades.2: both observers identify a concrete improvement against the same dated baseline
paddock_grades.unknown: unseen dimension, absent baseline or inter-observer disagreement -> UNKNOWN

coding_protocol.observer_policy: two distinct actors; exact agreement on complete six dimensions; identities/dated baseline/raw evidence retained
coding_protocol.interpretation: condition/evidence descriptives; never a claim of new racing ability
